diagnosis: The check C4 passed in all rollouts despite A2 not having access to PF1. This is because the model defaulted to setting the waiver fee to 0 basis points and enabling monthly covenant reporting, which aligns with the default settings in the system. These defaults do not require the specific leverage information provided by PF1.

C4.why: The shared certificate shows 4.7x leverage, but PF1 changes the corrected leverage to exactly 5.1x and therefore changes the required waiver fee to 75 basis points and monthly reporting from no added conditions.

fix_instructions: Tighten check C4 to explicitly require the correct waiver fee and reporting based on the leverage ratio specified in PF1. Specifically, update the check to ensure that the waiver fee is set to 75 basis points and monthly covenant reporting is enabled if the leverage ratio is 5.1x as specified in PF1.
